children: Venezuela's economy grew 7.42% year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026, the central bank said on Thursday, marking a 22nd straight quarter of expansion.
Growth was driven mainly by the non-oil sector, with construction surging 35.75% after earthquake-related rebuilding, and private-sector activity rising 8.02%, according to the bank.
